editorial.name: Storytale
editorial.descriptionZh: 订阅制图形素材库，货架分 3D illustrations、Vector illustrations、Mockups 三段，素材由独立设计师供稿，另有定制设计入口。
editorial.takeawayZh: 订一年，把 3D 插画和矢量图打包下走
editorial.noteZh: 首屏是灰底白卡，顶上一条 Product Hunt 的橙色徽章写 Top #1 Product of the week，标题 Save on designing for your next startup idea，下面直接摆搜索框，占位是 Search for assets，快捷标签是 eg. error 404 / cryptocurrency / shopping / business。往下三段货架分别是 3D illustrations、Vector illustrations、Mockups，每段一句说明加 Explore all … packs。页脚写 Over 6000 assets 与 Get once, use forever，配 4.9/5、75 Reviews on Product Hunt，另留一条 Didn't find what you were looking for? Order custom design。
editorial.pricing: Paid（年订阅；首页写 yearly subscription，另留 /plans 与 /order-custom）

reasons.statement: 站内三段货架 3D illustrations / Vector illustrations / Mockups 都是可下载的图形素材，用户动作是订阅后 Download graphics，归图标字体与视觉素材下的插画与矢量素材。
不归样机与品牌展示模板：主页三段里只有一段是 Mockups，主推的 3D 与矢量插画才是货架主体。
